title: Cost Bound for Flattened Formulas
statement: Let $xs$ be a finite list and assign to each element $x$ a conjunctive normal form $f(x)$. If every $x$ occurring in $xs$ has cost at most $B$, then the cost of concatenating all the formulas $f(x)$ for $x$ in $xs$ is at most $|xs|B$.
